name: Bear
tagline: Elegant Markdown note-taking app for Mac and iOS
painPoints: Apple-only: no Android, Windows, or Linux support
Sync between devices requires the paid Bear Pro plan
No proactive AI features; note-taking is entirely manual
No email, calendar, or task integration
Beautiful but passive — Bear never helps you do anything automatically
metaTitle: Bear App Alternative for Windows and Linux: Notes With AI
metaDescription: Bear is Apple-only and charges for sync. GAIA works in any browser and on Windows and Linux, and captures knowledge from your email. See how to move your notes.
whyPeopleLook: Bear is celebrated as one of the most elegant note-taking apps on Apple platforms, with its clean Markdown editor, nested tags, and beautiful themes. But it is entirely passive — you write in Bear, and Bear stores what you write. It cannot read your email to capture correspondence context, does not know about your calendar, and has no AI that surfaces relevant notes when you need them. Users who leave Apple's ecosystem or who want their notes tool to be more active in their workflow consistently look for alternatives.
gaiaReplaces: Cross-platform note access on Android, Windows, and Linux
Automatic knowledge capture from email and calendar events
Proactive retrieval of relevant past notes based on current context
Meeting context memory without writing notes manually
gaiaAdvantages: Works on every platform including Android, Windows, Linux, and web
Knowledge is captured automatically from your digital activity
No sync paywall: all platforms included in the free tier
Source-available and self-hostable unlike Bear's closed app
Proactive assistant that connects notes to email, tasks, and calendar
migrationSteps: Export Bear notes as Markdown via File > Export Notes
Import Markdown files into GAIA's memory system for semantic search
Connect Gmail and Google Calendar for automatic knowledge enrichment
Access notes and knowledge from any device via GAIA's cross-platform apps

faqs.question: Does GAIA have as polished a writing experience as Bear?
faqs.answer: Bear's Markdown editor is widely considered best-in-class for Apple platforms. GAIA's interface is conversational and action-oriented rather than a rich text editor. For long-form writing, Bear remains a better writing environment.

faqs.question: Can GAIA work on Android and Windows unlike Bear?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA has apps for Android, iOS, web, desktop (Windows and macOS), and bot interfaces. Bear is limited to Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

faqs.question: Is GAIA free where Bear requires a subscription for sync?
faqs.answer: Bear Pro is a paid plan with sync across devices. GAIA syncs across your devices out of the box. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs) with no feature restrictions tied to sync.

faqs.question: Can GAIA ingest my existing Bear notes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Export your Bear notes as Markdown and import them into GAIA's memory system. GAIA will index the content for semantic retrieval and surface relevant notes proactively.
